US Naval Presence and Oil Flow in Strait of Hormuz

Despite increased oil flows, Iran continues to pose a threat in the Strait of Hormuz. The United States maintains a naval presence in the region, with questions arising about the effectiveness of these efforts in light of oil prices approaching $100 per barrel. The situation involves ongoing tensions and strategic maneuvering in a critical global waterway.
